//_antenna_history: MEASURED LADDER. run_2 (no heuristic, 1 GRT pass): 129 pin / 86 net antenna, 950 diodes, 0 slew, 0 fanout. run_4 (threshold 90 + deprecated DIODE_INSERTION_STRATEGY 3): 9/9 antenna but 22826 diodes, 687 slew, 2151 fanout - a diode on ~every input pin doubles each net's pin count and is added AFTER the resizer, so nothing repairs the damage. run_5 (threshold 250): 29/29 antenna, 6654 diodes, 621 slew, 726 fanout (604 data + 122 clock). run_6 (threshold 200, below) is the next step: run_5's 29 violations are all marginal - worst ratio 2.09, 28 of 29 below 1.75 - so a modest drop should clear most of them without returning to run_4's diode flood.
//_antenna_now: STOPPING RULE - read before changing this. Antenna and slew/fanout move in OPPOSITE directions, so there may be no value that zeroes both. Accept the run when data-fanout and slew are near zero and any surviving antenna violations are few with ratios close to 1.0; then DISCLOSE those in the report with their ratios from reports/signoff/*-antenna_violators.rpt. Do NOT keep lowering the threshold chasing 0/0 - that is how run_4 got 22826 diodes. Verify every run with: python3 check_signoff.py runs/<run>
//_diode_strategy: DIODE_INSERTION_STRATEGY is deliberately NOT set. It is deprecated in OpenLane and value 3 duplicates what RUN_HEURISTIC_DIODE_INSERTION already does, which is how run_4 ended up with 22826 diodes.
//_decap: Drop sky130_ef_sc_hd__decap_12 from the default DECAP_CELL list. It is an efabless-generated cell with no subcircuit in the PDK CDL, which made CVC/ERC abort with 'could not find subcircuit ... (sky130_ef_sc_hd__decap_12)' in run_4. KEEP THIS OVERRIDE: it worked. In run_5 CVC got much further - it parsed the whole netlist (106167 instances, 139835 nets, 362924 devices) before failing on a different, unrelated problem. See //_cvc_status below.
//_klayout_drc: run_4 skipped KLayout DRC entirely ('KLAYOUT_DRC_TECH_SCRIPT is not defined ... will be skipped') and reported klayout_violations = -1. The sky130A PDK ships the runset but does not populate this variable. Point it at the runset explicitly. If the flow still skips the step on your OpenLane version, run OpenLane/secure_asic_top/run_klayout_drc.sh after the flow instead.
//_cvc_status: run_5 CVC aborts at the Setting-models stage with: unexpected error: Resistance error: missing parameter: l in l/w*48. 48 ohm/sq is the sky130 non-silicided poly sheet resistance, so some device in the extracted CDL is being matched to a poly-resistor model without an l parameter. This is a PDK/tool model-resolution problem, NOT a design error: CVC never reached the checking stage, and Magic DRC, KLayout DRC and Netgen LVS all independently report zero. FAKEDIODE_CELL was investigated and RULED OUT - DIODE_INSERTION_STRATEGY is unset, so sky130_ef_sc_hd__fakediode_2 is never instantiated. To identify the real culprit locally, run: python3 diagnose_cvc.py runs/run_6  (needs tmp/signoff/*.cdl, which exists on the build machine but is excluded from packaged ZIPs).
//_signoff: Keep every signoff check explicitly on so each run regenerates its own DRC/LVS/XOR/ERC evidence.
